question: What is said in the Traiśirasa Tantra concerning the all-fulfilling nature?
premises: In the Traiśirasa Tantra it is said to be all-fulfilling-natured.
By the root-rising path it is flooded with the Shiva-moon.
inference: The all-fulfilling nature is stated in the Traiśirasa Tantra, while the root-rising path floods it with the Shiva-moon.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the all-fulfilling nature is not explicit.
Whether śivendu denotes Shiva-moon or Shiva and moon is ambiguous.
The precise syntactic force of tu is unclear.
plain_english: In the Traiśirasa Tantra it is said to be all-fulfilling; yet by the root-rising path it is flooded with the Shiva-moon.
